scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'm looking for adventurers who are at least Level 130, healthy, free of chronic disease, and not on prescription drugs.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
我正在尋找等級至少130級、身體健康、無慢性病且未服用處方藥的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Hello, Adventurer. I'm Charleston, the initiator of the Project Independent.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
你好，冒險者。我是查爾斯頓，“獨立計劃”的發起人。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Currently I'm unable to move, having a problem with one of my components. Could you help me get the replacement parts from the factory?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
我的一個部件出了故障，現在動不了了。
你能幫我去工廠取些替換零件嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
The task won't be difficult if you're at least Level 130, healthy, free of chronic disease, and not on prescription drugs.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
如果你等級至少130級，身體健康，無慢性病且未服用處方藥，這項任務就不會太難。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Please use the machine on the right side to enter the factory. Once you're in, remain calm and follow the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
請使用右側的機器進入工廠。進入後請保持冷靜，並遵循指示。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Please use the machine next to me to enter the factory. Once you're in, remain calm and follow the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
請使用我旁邊的機器進入工廠。進入後請保持冷靜，並遵循指示。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I don't know how long it's been standing here, but it's been a long time since I've been able to move...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
不知道在這裡站了多久...我已經很久不能動了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
At present, only my head can move, is Saleh she helped me open the organs can return to that time...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
現在只有頭還能動，是薩利赫幫我啟動了能回到那個時候的機關...

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I wouldn't have done that if I had been persuaded.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
要是當時有人勸住我，我就不會那麼做了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Anyway, I have nothing now... Only to be able to stand up again, so I hope to send an adventurer like you at that time.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
反正我現在已經一無所有...只盼著能重新站起來，所以想把你這樣的冒險者送回那個時候。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
^FF0000It didn't change anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
^FF0000什麼都沒有改變。^000000

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Just based on the hard work of OS... For your help in another part of the world Charleston 2 will be 'very good' robot!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
只能靠作業系統不斷努力了...
有了你在另一個時空的幫助，查爾斯頓 2號一定能成為“很好的”機器人！

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
It is possible to meet a good friend into a good robot, so I have to continue to carry on, Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
遇上好朋友，就有機會成為好機器人，所以我還得繼續努力。
謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Aren't you disappointed? Are you really going to let your effort go in vain? Because that'll be really stupid. I suggest you reconsider.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
你不甘心嗎？真打算讓之前的努力全都白費？那可太傻了。
我勸你再想想。

scripts.text: I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要還有一絲希望，我就再試一次

scripts.text: I'll think again.
scripts.translation: 我再想想

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'm a robot. I do what I'm programmed to do, and nothing else matters.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
我是機器人，只會按照程式行事，其他都不重要。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Ironic, isn't it? Robots are supposed to be incapable of emotions, and yet here I am, feeling rueful about the past.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
很諷刺吧？機器人本不該有情感，我卻在為過去懊悔。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
You can judge me, but you can't stop me. I'll continue to try as long as there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
你可以評判我，但你無法阻止我。只要還有一絲希望，我就會繼續嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
My heart stopped, but I still can talk. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
我的心跳停止了，但我還能說話。請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
If you're disillusioned by your immutable past, unclear future, and depressing present, then I won't force you.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
如果無法改變的過去、茫然的未來和壓抑的現在讓你灰了心，那我也不勉強。

scripts.text: I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要還有一絲希望，我就再試一次

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄了

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'll continue to try as long as there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
只要還有一絲希望，我就會繼續嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I couldn't stop it from happening or change the past. But maybe someone else can.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
我無法阻止它發生，也無法改變過去。但也許別人可以。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'll wait for that one person however long it takes.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓]
無論多久，我都會等待那個人。

scripts.text:
[Machine]
^ff0000You must be Level 130 to use this machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機器]
^ff0000您必須達到130級才能使用這臺機器。^000000

scripts.translation: 機器現在可以使用了。

scripts.text: Enter the Charleston Factory.
scripts.translation: 進入查爾斯頓工廠

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Crisis of Charleston Test ver130603a
scripts.translation: 查爾斯頓危機 測試版 ver130603a

scripts.text: 20 hour cooldown reset
scripts.translation: 重置20小時冷卻

scripts.text: Returns the status of the initial solution task
scripts.translation: 恢復初始任務狀態

scripts.text: Establish a copy clearance status
scripts.translation: 設定副本通關狀態

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Um... How long do I have to wait?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
呃...我還需要等多久？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Follow the leftward hallway, and remember that only you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
沿著左邊的走廊走，記住，只有你自己能保護自己。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Follow the leftward hallway, and remember that only you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
沿著左邊的走廊走，記住，只有你自己能保護自己。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Finally, you're here! I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
你終於來了！我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We don't have time, so let me cut to the chase. Currently, the Charleston Factory is under Rank B security alert level, meaning that the security devices have been activated.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
沒時間了，我就長話短說。
查爾斯頓工廠目前處於B級警戒，安保裝置都已啟動。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Move to the leftward hallway, destroy security devices in there, and then head on to the next zone.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
沿左側走廊前進，摧毀裡面的安保裝置，再去下一個區域。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Don't worry about the security devices. They can be repaired easily. Dr. Ve is in his lab north of Factory Line 3.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
不用擔心那些安保裝置，很容易修好的。
維博士就在3號生產線北側的實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Dr. Ve can tell you everything. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
維博士會告訴你一切。快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
#%@EGD&#(@#...
- She's making strange noises, but unable to move. -
scripts.translation: - 她發出奇怪的聲音，但無法移動。-

scripts.text: - He's busy scribbling something, Move close to talk to him.
scripts.translation: - 他正忙著寫什麼東西，靠近他才能交談。-

scripts.text: - He's busy scribbling something. You shouldn't disturb him.
scripts.translation: - 他正忙著寫什麼東西。你不應該打擾他。-

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Let me talk to your leader. I don't have time for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
讓我跟你的隊長談談。我沒時間應付所有人。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I don't care who you're with. I just need to know if you can help me.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
我不在乎你和誰在一起。我只想知道你能不能幫我。

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫忙

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Sigh, I don't care who, so long as I get the help I need.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
唉，誰都行，只要能幫上忙就好。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
You're the savior we've been waiting for! Charleston 1 will tell you what we need to repair Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
你就是我們盼望的救星！
要修好查爾斯頓 2號需要什麼，就讓查爾斯頓 1號告訴你吧。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1. Charleston 2 has been forcibly connected to a part of the main computer, and I can't control her.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 1號，2號被強制連線到主計算機的一部分，我已經控制不了她了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
She's a robot; she should stop sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
她是個機器人；她遲早會停下來的。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
The Longevity device in her will keep her running at least for 50 years. The factory is not going to survive that long.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
她體內的長壽裝置至少還能讓她運轉50年，工廠可撐不了那麼久。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Then we have no choice. It's good that we have the specialist with us.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
那我們別無選擇了。幸好有專家在場。

scripts.text: Are you talking about me?
scripts.translation: 你是在說我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
A while ago, a lady named ^FF0000Shalosh^000000 visited us while Charleston 2 was packaging products for shipping.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
不久前，一位名叫^FF0000沙洛什^000000的女士來訪時，查爾斯頓 2號正在打包產品準備發貨。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Shalosh and her friend were talking to Charleston 2 when the accident happened.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
事故發生時，沙洛什和她的朋友正在與查爾斯頓 2號交談。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I think someone tried to hack into the factory's main computer.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
我覺得有人試圖入侵工廠的主計算機。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
During its update process, the connection to the server was jammed. When we pressed Shalosh about that,
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
更新過程中，她與伺服器的連線受到了干擾。
我們就這事質問沙洛什，她說...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Shalosh said her friends could help us. That was when Newoz and her other friends came. They haven't been much of help.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
沙洛什說她的朋友可以幫我們。於是紐奧茲和其他朋友來了。但他們沒幫上什麼忙。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
It seems you're acquainted with them. Could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
看來你認識他們。你能幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫忙

scripts.text: I don't know them.
scripts.translation: 我不認識他們

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I just saw that you are talking, then I will wait for someone to help!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
可我剛才明明看到你們在說話。
那我再等其他人來幫忙吧！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Thank you so much! Give me some time to put some data in order. Then, I'll tell you what happened.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
非常感謝！請給我一點時間整理資料。然後，我會告訴你發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
When the tension is changed to two main lines and then injected into the core... well? I am not disturbing in the calculation.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
把張力調整到兩條主線路上，再注入核心...嗯？別打斷我計算。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader. The future of my factory depends on the success of this operation.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
請讓我跟你們的隊長談談，這次行動能否成功，關係到工廠的未來。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Steps and Locksteps are creating a mess inside the factory. Please destroy 3 Locksteps first. I can tell you their estimated locations.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
變異晶片和變異機器人正在工廠內製造混亂。請先消滅3只變異機器人。我可以告訴你它們的大致位置。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Let me explain what to do. Oh, let me close the factory entrance first, lest something might barge in uninvited.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
讓我解釋一下該怎麼做。哦，先讓我關閉工廠入口，以免有東西不請自來。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston is equipped with numerous Nanosteps, a type of AI chip that organically works with other AI chips to command Charleston to judge and act correctly.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
查爾斯頓裝有大量奈米晶片。
這種人工智慧晶片能彼此協作，讓查爾斯頓作出正確的判斷和行動。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston's data has to be updated on a daily basis through the main computer in the lab. We call this regular maintenance.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
查爾斯頓的資料必須每天通過實驗室的主計算機進行更新。我們稱之為定期維護。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
The updater is not working at this moment. We don't know the cause, but something went wrong while Charleston 2 was connecting to the main computer.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
更新器目前無法工作。我們不知道原因，但在查爾斯頓 2號連線主計算機時出了點問題。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I told Charleston 2 that she's under extended maintenance, but we don't know how long this extended maintenance status will last.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
我告訴查爾斯頓 2號，維護時間延長了，可誰也不知道還要持續多久。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Steps and Locksteps are creating a mess inside the factory. Please destroy 3 Locksteps first. I can tell you their estimated locations.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
變異晶片和變異機器人正在工廠內製造混亂。請先消滅3只變異機器人。我可以告訴你它們的大致位置。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
It'll be great if we can get rid of them all, but for now we should focus on having the factory up and running again.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
如果能把它們全部清除掉就好了，但現在我們應該先集中精力讓工廠重新運轉起來。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Destroying too many Steps could cause a problem to reactivate the factory. You should consult the main computer on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
消滅過多的變異晶片可能會導致工廠重啟時出現問題。你應該去諮詢左側的主計算機。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You should meet Dr. Ve first.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
你應該先去找維博士。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I am a robot, are you surprised?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
我是機器人，你感到驚訝嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
請讓我與你的隊長談談工廠補給的問題。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We need more power to reactivate the main computer. Let me tell you the location of one of the backup power generators. Turning it on is easy.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
重啟主計算機需要更多電力。
我把其中一臺備用發電機的位置告訴你，啟動它很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Whew, things seem to be settled for now. Let me disarm the alert mode and reactivate Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
呼，事情暫時解決了。讓我解除警報模式並重啟查爾斯頓 2號。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Err? This isn't right.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
咦？這不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I'm afraid there's a problem with the power generators. Could you check all the all three power generators? I'll tell you their locations.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
恐怕發電機出了點問題。你能檢查一下全部三個發電機嗎？我會告訴你它們的位置。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We're working on a new utility software engine called Hardworking. We haven't had a chance to test it because of the problems in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
我們正在開發一款名叫“勤勞”的新實用軟體引擎，可工廠出了問題，一直沒機會測試。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We're working on a new utility software engine called Hardworking. We haven't had a chance to test it because of the problems in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
我們正在開發一款名叫“勤勞”的新實用軟體引擎，可工廠出了問題，一直沒機會測試。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
請讓我與你的隊長談談工廠補給的問題。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're back. Charleston 2 is almost ready to be reactivated, and it's all thanks to you. Just give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
你回來了。
多虧你幫忙，查爾斯頓 2號馬上就能重啟了。
再等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
She's ready. Let's wait for a response from the main computer.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
她準備好了。讓我們等待主計算機的回應。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
89% of the main computer data has been restored. Reactivating Charleston 2 and the Charleston Factory...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
主計算機89%的資料已恢復。正在重啟查爾斯頓 2號和查爾斯頓工廠...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Oh, Charleston 2 is awake!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
哦，查爾斯頓 2號醒了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...Did I fail?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
...我失敗了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston 2! Are you all right? Someone hacked into your system and the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
查爾斯頓 2號！你沒事吧？有人黑進了你的系統和工廠。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
It was I who did it. I've thought about it for a long time, based on the reasoning of my Self-reflection OS.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
是我乾的。
我用自我反思作業系統推演了很久，才作出這個決定。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You did it? Why? Was it some sort of joke? You caused a serious error to the factory and the main server as well!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
是你？為什麼？你在開玩笑嗎？
你害得工廠和主伺服器都出了嚴重故障！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Not a joke. You'll never understand. You follow commands and never think on your own. I hate this factory, this world! I hate being a robot!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
不是玩笑，你永遠不會懂。
你只會服從命令，從來不自己思考。
我討厭這座工廠，討厭這個世界！我討厭當機器人！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Either a critical error has occurred or Charleston 2 has transcended the limits of the Self-reflection OS version 1.1.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
要麼是發生了嚴重錯誤，要麼是查爾斯頓 2號突破了自我反思作業系統1.1版本的限制。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Let me guess: you hate you weren't created as a menial worker robot.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
讓我猜猜，你不滿自己沒被造成一臺幹粗活的工人機器人。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Or you want to become a human.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
或者你想變成人類。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
And if you can't, then you want to destroy the whole world.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
如果做不到，你就想毀滅整個世界。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Is that it?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...Don't mock me.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
...別嘲笑我。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You had it coming. Your reasons are petulant and unimaginative. We're the first robots that can think for themselves. Can't you be more creative?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
是你自找的。
這些理由既任性又沒新意。
我們可是第一批能夠獨立思考的機器人，你就不能有點創意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
You don't know what you're talking about! You're the prototype--your OS version is primitive!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
你根本不懂！你不過是原型機，作業系統早就落伍了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I'm the only one in this world who can truly understand you.
We're twins.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
我是這個世界上唯一真正能理解你的人。
我們是雙胞胎。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're going through the adolescent stage like humans do.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
你就像人類一樣，正在經歷青春期。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Maybe we should celebrate. You've finally developed human-like feelings.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
也許我們應該慶祝一下。你終於產生了類似人類的情感。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Don't act like you know everything! We can't think for ourselves. Everything we think we know has been programmed into us!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
少裝出一副什麼都懂的樣子！我們根本不能獨立思考，連自以為知道的東西都是程式預先設定的！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Enough. Let's shut down Charleston 2. Her AI needs to be recalibrated.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
夠了。讓我們關閉查爾斯頓 2號。她的AI需要重新校準。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
But...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
That's not happening! I still have control over this factory! Don't you dare follow me!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
那是不可能的！我仍然控制著這座工廠！別想跟著我！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Stop acting like a child!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
別像個孩子一樣鬧了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Her Longevity device is discharged; she won't make it far. Please follow her.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
她的長壽裝置已經耗盡電力，她走不了多遠。請跟上她。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
This is the safety of the Charleston factory. Please stay close?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
這裡關係到查爾斯頓工廠的安全，請跟緊我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
請讓我與你的隊長談談工廠補給的問題。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Stop following! I'm going to destroy the whole factory!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
別跟著我！我要摧毀整座工廠！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're going to destroy us in the process! Our main power supply, Longevity, isn't perfect yet!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
那樣連我們也會一起毀掉的！我們的主電源“長壽”裝置還不完善！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
None of you understand me. I hate you!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
你們誰都不理解我。我恨你們！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
The main computer may have been restored, but I'm still connected to the factory. Stop me if you can!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
主計算機就算恢復了，我仍然連著這座工廠。
有本事就來阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
I'm going to destroy the whole factory!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
我要摧毀整座工廠！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston 2 is on the verge of break;down. Could you help her?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
查爾斯頓 2號快要崩潰了。你能幫幫她嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Oh, our lab won't survive this!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
噢，我們的實驗室撐不過這一遭了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Do you think you can stop me? *Snort* Bring your leader. I'm not talking to you!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
你覺得你能阻止我嗎？*哼* 叫你們的隊長來。我才不跟你說話！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Enough with this! I understand you're going through a lot of emotional turmoil, but it's getting ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
夠了！我知道你心裡很亂，可你鬧得也太過火了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
How dare you bring strangers into this? I told you I'm serious about this! Outdated versions like you can never understand me!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
你竟敢把陌生人帶到這裡？我說了我是認真的！像你這種過時的版本永遠無法理解我！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I may not understand you, but at least I'm telling you what I think is true.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
也許我不懂你，可我說的至少都是自己的真心話。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're right about me being a lower version. My capability of emotions is minimal, unlike you. That's why I'm proud of you.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
你說得對，我的版本確實比你低，情感能力也遠遠不及你。
正因如此，我才為你驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Nothing you feel, you think is your own--it's programmed into you! I'm different. What I feel is real emotion!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
你以為自己的感受和想法屬於自己，其實全都是程式設定的！
我不一樣，我感受到的才是真正的情感！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Enough. I'll destroy Charleston 2 if that's what it takes to stop her.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
夠了。如果必須摧毀查爾斯頓 2號才能阻止她，那我就這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Is Charleston 3 already completed?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
查爾斯頓 3號已經完成了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston 3? That's a combat/defense unit based on Charleston 2's and my designs. I thought it's still being tested at the Core.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
查爾斯頓 3號？那是以我和查爾斯頓 2號為基礎設計的戰鬥防禦機型。
我以為她還在核心區接受測試。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1, that's too much information.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 1號，你透露了太多資訊。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
At this moment, ^FF0000anybody can access the model^000000 because its OS is still being tested to correct whatever problem Charleston 2 has.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
現在^FF0000誰都能接入那臺機體^000000，因為她的作業系統還在測試，目的是修正查爾斯頓 2號存在的問題。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
You've just told the most critical information to everyone!
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
你剛剛把最關鍵的資訊告訴了所有人！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
^FF0000We^000000're incapable of combat. If someone activates Charleston 3, we won't stand a chance against her.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
^FF0000我們^000000不具備戰鬥能力。如果有人啟用查爾斯頓 3號，我們將毫無勝算。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
I'm taking Charleston 3 with me.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
我要帶走查爾斯頓 3號。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
What? No! How can you even consider that?
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
什麼？不！你怎麼能這麼想？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Things are getting more serious. Please go to the Core in the center of the factory before Charleston 2 steals 3!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
事情越來越嚴重了。
快去工廠中央的核心區，別讓查爾斯頓 2號搶走3號！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...I am responsible for the 3rd machine.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
...我是負責3號機的。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Things are getting messier.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
事情越來越混亂了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 2 is defective.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 2號有故障。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
This Core in the center powers the entire factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
這個位於中央的核心為整個工廠提供動力。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
In order to unlock the device, a blasting device is required, and I want to talk to the leader.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
要開啟這個裝置，得用爆破裝置。
請隊長來和我談談。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Could you bring 1 Explosive Powder? I'm stuck to the access device, as you can see.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
能帶1份炸彈粉末過來嗎？你也看到了，我被困在接入裝置這裡，脫不開身。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Oh, thank you. With this,I'll be able to access the Core.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
哦，謝謝。
有了這個，就能進入核心區了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
If I use the explosives to intensify the electric current...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
如果我用炸藥增強電流...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Voila!!!
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
搞定！！！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...You just blew up the door.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
...你剛把門炸開了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
The point is that we can now access the Core.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
重點是，現在能進核心區了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Let's have a race to Charleston 3. Whoever reaches her first wins.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
我們來比賽誰先到達查爾斯頓 3號。誰先到誰就贏。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
This Core in the center powers the entire factory.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
這個位於中央的核心為整個工廠提供動力。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
The Charleston Factory is under my control now. I'm destroying everything, so no more sad robots like me will ever see the world.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
查爾斯頓工廠已經歸我控制。
我要毀掉這裡的一切，讓世界上再也不會誕生像我這樣可悲的機器人！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
99 Explosive Powders? Easy.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
99份炸彈粉末？小意思。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
#%@EGD&#(@#... Reinitializing the OS...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
#%@EGD&#(@#...正在重新初始化作業系統...

scripts.text: She's making strange noises and not functioning.
scripts.translation: 她發出奇怪的聲音，無法正常工作。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
#%@EGD&#(@#... Reinitializing the OS...
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 1號]
#%@EGD&#(@#...正在重新初始化作業系統...

scripts.text: She's making strange noises and not functioning.
scripts.translation: 她發出奇怪的聲音，無法正常工作。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Come to think of it, everything about Dr. Ve was suspicious. I mean, he relied on his assistant Charleston 1 for everything.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
仔細想想，維博士的一切都很可疑。我是說，他事事都依賴他的助手查爾斯頓 1號。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Only Dr. Ve know can answer my question. I must find him. He must be in the lab.
scripts.translation:
[查爾斯頓 2號]
只有維博士能回答我的問題。我必須找到他。他一定在實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
With complete machine technology to obtain immortality drive, there are many variables.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
單靠機械技術獲得永生，變數還是太多了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Hmm... On a mediated machine body is still difficult, is it... Do you really need a living donor? Hehe!
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
嗯...以機械軀體為媒介，還是太困難了嗎...難道真得用活體供體？嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1 is reinitializing itself again. Hm...
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 1號又在重新初始化了。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I've got so many things to record about this case.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
關於這個案例，我有太多東西需要記錄了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
With complete machine technology to obtain immortality drive, there are many variables.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
單靠機械技術獲得永生，變數還是太多了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Hmm... On a mediated machine body is still difficult, is it... Do you really need a living donor? Hehe!
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
嗯...以機械軀體為媒介，還是太困難了嗎...難道真得用活體供體？嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
No ordinary human can survive the time in the Core. Are you from a different point of time?
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
普通人類無法在核心中存活那麼久。你來自不同的時間點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Perhaps you're from the time the makers of Charleston 1 lived...
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
也許你來自查爾斯頓 1號製造者生活的時代...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Never mind. You have no business in here. Just go back to whoever broke Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
算了。你不該在這裡。回去找那個弄壞查爾斯頓 2號的人吧。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Whew.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
呼。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I'd better reset Charleston 2 and wipe the data. It was really close this time.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
我最好重置查爾斯頓 2號並清除資料。這次真的太危險了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This time?

[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1 created 2 decades ago. I met Charleston 1 to learn her technology.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 1號是幾十年前製造的。
我找上她，就是為了學習她的技術。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I'm an observer. I'm here to record the history of Charlestons 1 and 2. I can't repair either of them, but I can wait.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
我是個觀察者，來記錄查爾斯頓 1號和2號的歷史。
她們兩個我誰也修不好，不過我可以等。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
If Charleston 1 is reinitialized properly, she can reorganize her OS, repair the damage done to her, and reactivate another Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
只要查爾斯頓 1號順利完成重新初始化，就能重組作業系統，修復自身損傷，再啟動一臺新的查爾斯頓 2號。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Another Charleston 2?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另一個查爾斯頓 2號？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 2's OS has improved on its own like a living brain.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 2號的作業系統像活體大腦一樣自我進化了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Every time Charleston 2 comes back to life, though in a different machine, she's more intelligent, more sensible, and more troublesome.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
每次查爾斯頓 2號換一具機體重新啟動，都會變得更聰明、更懂事，也更麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
There's nothing you or I can do. We'll have to wait until Charleston 1 repairs herself.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
你和我都無能為力。我們只能等待查爾斯頓 1號修復她自己。

scripts.text: Dr. Ve sighs and writes down something.
scripts.translation: 維博士嘆了口氣，寫下了一些東西。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
By the way, there are too many variables to achieve immortality through mechanical engineering.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
話說回來，想靠機械工程實現永生，變數實在太多。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
This proves that machines are too dangerous. I need live creatures instead. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
這就證明了機械太危險，還是得用活物才行。
嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1 is reinitializing itself again. Hm...
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
查爾斯頓 1號又在重新初始化了。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I've got so many things to record about this case.
scripts.translation:
[維博士]
關於這個案例，我有太多東西需要記錄了。

scripts.text: She's in Sleep mode and not moving.
scripts.translation: 她處於休眠模式，一動不動。

scripts.text: Charleston 2 is standing still, her system in Sleep mode. For a moment, her eyes gleamed with unshed tears.
scripts.translation: 查爾斯頓 2號靜靜地站著，系統處於睡眠模式。一瞬間，她的眼中閃爍著未落的淚光。

scripts.text: Charleston 2 is standing still, her system in Sleep mode. For a moment, her eyes gleamed with unshed tears.
scripts.translation: 查爾斯頓 2號靜靜地站著，系統處於睡眠模式。一瞬間，她的眼中閃爍著未落的淚光。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
......
Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: I need help.
scripts.translation: 我需要幫助

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
After break;ing up with Newoz in a nightmare and thinking about wandering around, I was born of demons but lost my goal.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
在噩夢中與紐奧茲分別後，我便想著四處遊蕩。
我雖是魔族所生，卻失去了目標。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
I didn't do anything, I just talked to Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
我什麼也沒做，只是和查爾斯頓 2號聊了聊天。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Even if the effort is unremitting...
scripts.translation:

即使努力不懈...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Hmm... Suit yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
嗯...隨你便吧！

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Did she really say that? That I broke Charleston 2? Sigh...
scripts.translation:

她真的那麼說了嗎？說我弄壞了查爾斯頓 2號？唉...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
I did nothing wrong. I just had a quick conversation with Charleston 2. That's the truth.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
我沒有做錯任何事。我只是和查爾斯頓 2號簡單聊了聊。這就是事實。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
I invited only Newoz. Well, I guess I shouldn't have opened the door for the robot who needed a closure.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
我只邀請了紐奧茲。
唉，或許我不該替那個想求個了結的機器人開啟那扇門。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
If you're looking for something...

如果你在尋找什麼...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
If you're looking for something...

如果你在尋找什麼...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

費雷跟我一起來的，可我一直沒看見他。
不用幫忙，謝謝，我知道他會回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
The noise stopped. I can send you back to where you came if you want.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
噪音停止了。如果你想回去，我可以送你回到你來的地方。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
The invitee is unable to interfere with the original time, and staying can change nothing.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
受邀者無法干涉原本的時間，留下來也改變不了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Both the noise and the story were entertaining. Come with Newoz, and maybe we can meet again.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
噪音和故事都很有趣。和紐奧茲一起走吧，也許我們還能再見面。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Maybe I too should leave for new noises and stories.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
也許我也該去尋找新的噪音和故事了。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
You can try, but you can't change anything. How futile that is!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
你可以試試，但什麼都改變不了。真是徒勞啊！

scripts.translation:
[IGU]

scripts.text:
[IGU]
Enjoying the adventure? There are machines everywhere. It used to be a study. See those books over there?
scripts.translation:
[IGU]
冒險還開心嗎？這裡到處都是機器。
這裡以前是間書房，看到那邊的書了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I was reading a letter from Shalosh, and the next thing I knew, I was in a completely different place. Oh well, I might as well use this chance to write a new song.
scripts.translation:
[紐奧茲]
我在讀沙洛什的信，回過神來，我就在一個完全不同的地方了。算了，我正好可以利用這個機會寫一首新歌。

scripts.text: The bookcase is filled with research journals.
scripts.translation: 書架上擺滿了研究日誌。

scripts.text: Every page is written in mechanical language.
scripts.translation: 每一頁都用機械語言書寫。

我真的理解人類嗎？

scripts.text: -It doesn't matter. Now I'm happy to see her, my best friend, my baby, Lily...

現在只要看到她，我就很開心，我最好的朋友，我的寶貝，莉莉...
